calls.statement:
SELECT f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, count(*) AS n, sum(f.quantity) AS qty, min(f.sales_line_id) AS min_id, max(f.sales_line_id) AS max_id, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, max(f.staff_purchase_flag::int) AS staff, min(f.channel_code) cc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT f.sale_date, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS helsinki_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_id
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06' OR CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04')
ORDER BY f.sale_ts_utc
